question: How did availability, effectiveness and quality ratio develop per week in Q4 2025?
restatement: You want to see how availability, quality ratio and effectiveness developed per week, from 1 Oct 2025 to 31 Dec 2025.

result.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', "f"."shift_date") AS "week", (100 * ((COALESCE(SUM("f"."run_minutes" / 60.0), 0))) / NULLIF((COALESCE(SUM("f"."planned_busy_minutes" / 60.0), 0)), 0)) AS "availability", (100 * ((COALESCE(SUM("f"."good_qty"), 0))) / NULLIF((COALESCE(SUM("f"."produced_qty"), 0)), 0)) AS "quality_ratio", (100 * ((COALESCE(SUM("f"."ideal_minutes" / 60.0), 0))) / NULLIF((COALESCE(SUM("f"."run_minutes" / 60.0), 0)), 0)) AS "effectiveness" FROM "main"."fct_production_shifts" AS "f" WHERE "f"."shift_date" >= CAST('2025-10-01' AS DATE) AND "f"."shift_date" <= CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE) GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', "f"."shift_date") ORDER BY "week" ASC LIMIT 10000

steps.label: availability before and after 3 Nov
steps.sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN "week" < CAST('2025-11-03' AS DATE) THEN 'before' ELSE 'after' END AS "period", AVG("availability") AS "availability"
FROM (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', "f"."shift_date") AS "week", (100 * ((COALESCE(SUM("f"."run_minutes" / 60.0), 0))) / NULLIF((COALESCE(SUM("f"."planned_busy_minutes" / 60.0), 0)), 0)) AS "availability", (100 * ((COALESCE(SUM("f"."good_qty"), 0))) / NULLIF((COALESCE(SUM("f"."produced_qty"), 0)), 0)) AS "quality_ratio", (100 * ((COALESCE(SUM("f"."ideal_minutes" / 60.0), 0))) / NULLIF((COALESCE(SUM("f"."run_minutes" / 60.0), 0)), 0)) AS "effectiveness" FROM "main"."fct_production_shifts" AS "f" WHERE "f"."shift_date" >= CAST('2025-10-01' AS DATE) AND "f"."shift_date" <= CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE) GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', "f"."shift_date") ORDER BY "week" ASC LIMIT 10000
) AS "answer"
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY MIN("week")

steps.label: the routine band of quality ratio
steps.sql:
SELECT MIN("quality_ratio") AS "lowest", MAX("quality_ratio") AS "highest"
FROM (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', "f"."shift_date") AS "week", (100 * ((COALESCE(SUM("f"."run_minutes" / 60.0), 0))) / NULLIF((COALESCE(SUM("f"."planned_busy_minutes" / 60.0), 0)), 0)) AS "availability", (100 * ((COALESCE(SUM("f"."good_qty"), 0))) / NULLIF((COALESCE(SUM("f"."produced_qty"), 0)), 0)) AS "quality_ratio", (100 * ((COALESCE(SUM("f"."ideal_minutes" / 60.0), 0))) / NULLIF((COALESCE(SUM("f"."run_minutes" / 60.0), 0)), 0)) AS "effectiveness" FROM "main"."fct_production_shifts" AS "f" WHERE "f"."shift_date" >= CAST('2025-10-01' AS DATE) AND "f"."shift_date" <= CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE) GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', "f"."shift_date") ORDER BY "week" ASC LIMIT 10000
) AS "answer"
